title: Turing Post 'Inference' with Ksenia Se: Eric on incorruptible companies, AI disruption, and the future of capitalism
summary: Ksenia Se, founder of AI newsletter Turing Post, drops a 31-minute Inference podcast episode with Eric for an audience of ML engineers, data scientists, and AI builders — pulling the book's argument into the AI-builder frame.
blockquote:
What if the biggest threat to a great company isn't failure — but success? And why it becomes even more relevant now – when everyone becomes an AI builder?

Eric Ries, entrepreneur and author of The Lean Startup and Incorruptible, argues that the more valuable a company becomes, the more pressure it faces to make money without creating real value. In other words: corruption in business doesn't begin at the margins. It begins when builders stop protecting what made their company worth building in the first place.
blockquote_source: Ksenia Se on Turing Post's YouTube channel
attribution_title: Founder, Turing Post; publisher of the AI newsletter and Inference podcast
